management_steps.details: Pain out of proportion to injury, pain on passive stretch, tense swollen compartment, decreased cap refill. Pulses are usually PRESENT (absent pulse is a late, catastrophic sign).
Normal: < 10 mmHg. Perform emergent Fasciotomy if: absolute compartment pressure > 30 mmHg OR perfusion pressure < 30 mmHg (DBP - compartment pressure).
Urgently consult ortho/general surgery. Remove all constrictive dressings/casts. Place limb AT THE LEVEL OF THE HEART (do not elevate). Avoid nerve blocks.
